organization: Karnataka State Habitat Centre (client of record). The festival itself is staged by the Government of Karnataka with the Vijayanagara district administration.
location: Hampi, Vijayanagara district, Karnataka — UNESCO World Heritage Site
identityConfidence: EVENT: HIGH. Three-day state festival at Hampi in early February 2024, staged by the Government of Karnataka against the UNESCO-listed ruins, with parades, elephants, cultural stages, fireworks and a light-and-sound show. CLIENT ROLE: MEDIUM — the Karnataka State Habitat Centre is named as Raja's client but is not the festival's public organiser; it is presumably the implementing or procuring agency.
